paper.title: A reprogrammable mechanical metamaterial with origami functional-group transformation and ring reconfiguration

evidence.paraphrase: Four MW bases form one element; four C-I/C-II/C-III/R initial-angle choices are tabulated.

evidence.locator: Main Methods: Thick facet design; SI Figs.26–27
evidence.paraphrase: Resin facets, TPU creases and printed support/connection parts are described; no complete printer or postprocessing recipe is supplied.
Hinge screw and crease sequence, protruding-screw trimming, sliding facet-III closure and frame interfaces are described.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.2b; SI Figs.13,27; Movie1 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: Physical crease tendency demonstration; exact manipulation sequence is not recovered.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.2c and Methods: Uniaxial mechanical tests
evidence.paraphrase: Four mechanical element classes; Methods reports three prototypes per type, 10 mm/min and 20 Hz, with a compression/tension wording conflict.
Physical force/deformation comparison distinguishes transverse F1/F2 and axial F3.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.2d; SI Fig.27d; Movie3 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: C and R elements form a transformable functional group with aligned hinge axes.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.3; SI Figs.23a,31a; Movies4–5 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: Triangular rings demonstrate torsional expansion/contraction and functional transformation.

evidence.locator: SI Figs.30–31; Main Fig.3 discussion; Movie6 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: Square rings demonstrate torsional behavior and C/R transformation.

evidence.locator: Main Methods: Semi-experimental method; SI Discussion8A, Eqs.43–44 and Fig.29
evidence.paraphrase: Torque is calculated from element measurements and measured ring geometry, not directly acquired by a torque transducer.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.4; SI Figs.28,32–33; Movie7 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: Square rings show two loading orientations, zero-Poisson and auxetic deformations; some SI caption directions conflict.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.5a–c; SI Figs.28,34–36; Movie8 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: Intermediate ring configurations have direction/angle-dependent response; exact measured angle grid is not recovered.
Endpoint morphology is demonstrated; the illustrated 0-degree configuration does not establish independent measurements at both endpoints.

evidence.locator: Main Methods: Fabrication and experiment testing of periodic homogeneous quadrilateral ring metamaterials; SI Fig.38
evidence.paraphrase: Precreased 180 g/m2 cardboard, 30 mm elements, frames/connectors and six rings in a 3x2 array form a separate physical route.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.6b–c; SI Fig.39; Movie10 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: C-III paper-array compression has seven fixed angle conditions.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.6d–e; SI Fig.40; Movie11 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: C-I paper-array tension has seven fixed angle conditions.

evidence.locator: SI Fig.41; Main periodic-metamaterial discussion; Movie12 referenced, unread
evidence.paraphrase: C-III/R array transformation and coexistence are qualitative; connector recess/block variant is shown.
Geometry, energy, deformation and constitutive relations include analytical/numerical work, not additional measured specimen runs.

evidence.locator: Main Fig.7 and Potential applications; SI Figs.42–44
evidence.paraphrase: Robotics and mechanical/electrical computing examples are proposals/schematics, not confirmed application-hardware experiments.

robot_translation: All robot tools, carrier/dock interfaces, safe-state receipts, calibration checks and recovery policies are authored design requirements, not reported robotic experiments.
